metadata.name: GetLoyaltyRuleQualifiedDetails
metadata.description: This API is to show the details of Loyalty Rule setup for the transaction of an account.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid). Valid Values:0-9 Example:12345 Condition : At least one Account identifier input parameter should be passed.

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896325874 Condition : At least one Account identifier input parameter should be passed. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AuthTranID
request_fields.description: Authrorization Transaction ID,to identify we need to decline it or approve it. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:12343235235235 Condition:Either ClearingTranID or AuthTranID can be pass. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: ClearingTranID
request_fields.description: Clearing Transaction ID Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXX Example:123654789 Condition:Either ClearingTranID or AuthTranID can be pass. Allowable Values: 19

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.description: Authrorization Transaction ID, to identify we need to decline it or approve it. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12343235235235

children.name: LoyaltyProgramName
children.description: Name of Loyalty Program Valid Values:A-Z,a-z Example: Card Loyalty Program Allowable Values: 50

children.name: RuleID
children.description: ID of Loyalty Rule. Valid Values:  0-9(Value provided by Corecard) Format:XXXXX Example:1236

children.name: RuleName
children.description: Name of the Loyalty Rule. Valid Values: A-Z,a-z,0-9 Format:XXXXXXX Example:1236547 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: RuleDescription
children.description: Description of the Loyalty Rule. Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example:1% Reward on All Activities Allowable Values: 550

children.name: RuleType
children.description: Flag to decide the type of Loyalty Rule.refer Appendix 5.39 section of Appendix Valid Values:0-9 Format:X Example:1- Promotional

children.name: Priority
children.description: Decided the priority of loyalty rule. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 1

children.name: RuleApplication
children.description: Type of transaction on which the Loyalty rule should trigger for the Account. Refer Appendix 5.40 section Valid Values:0-9,A-z Format:X Example: 1-Purchase Allowable Values: 50

children.name: RuleSetUpOn
children.description: Addtional criteria on which Loyalty rule should trigger for the Account. Refer Appendix 5.41 section for values. Valid Values:0-9 Format:X Example: 4- SKU, 7- Product Code Allowable Values: 50
